title: EU goes to Syria to talk business amid wider worries over lingering Russian influence and Jordanian attack
lede: The EU is spearheading efforts next week to get Syria back on its feet, followed by an investment conference in Jordan. But Russian influence and recent lethal Jordanian fighter-jet attacks in southern Syria point to lingering issues.
